subject: 千寻塔意象，ch01大理1093（原创构图，细部待考）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: tianshu default building-map, a single reusable transparent PNG building, realistic historical Chinese architectural materials, no ink painting or miniature toy. Orthographic dimetric 2:1 projection, yaw45 pitch30, two horizontal ground axes have screen slopes +0.5 and -0.5, vertical pillars exactly vertical, NO perspective convergence. Front faces screen lower left. Grey clay tiles, weathered timber, understated plaster and stone, believable Song-period structural joinery, low-saturation warm natural colors. Thin flat rectangular footprint foundation, clearly visible straight front and right base edges, no chunky diorama pedestal. Entire building including eaves and thin footprint inside canvas, at least 10% transparent padding on all sides. Sunlight from SCREEN UPPER LEFT, short subtle contact shadow toward SCREEN LOWER RIGHT. TRUE transparent RGBA canvas, no background sky, floor, scenery or checkerboard. No text, signs, pseudo-writing, letters, watermark, logo, humans, modern objects, Qing yellow palace roofs, Japanese torii, dramatic extreme eaves. Generate exactly ONE asset in a square 1024x1024 composition. ONE solitary Qianxun Pagoda in Dali in 1093: an extremely slender gently tapering SQUARE white brick tower with EXACTLY SIXTEEN very closely spaced horizontal courses of projecting BRICK ledges (dense-eave type). These ledges are flat shallow brick cornices, NOT individual tiled pavilion roofs, NO upturned eaves, NO timber galleries. Tall first storey, subsequent fifteen short levels, small dark arched niche in alternating levels. Modest tiny metal finial. Square 7m x7m thin stone ground footprint. Front base edge and right base edge slope exactly +0.5 / -0.5, elevation clearly viewed from30 degrees downward. Entire tower in frame.
negative: no text, watermarks, modern elements, perspective convergence, thick pedestal, opaque background
created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 已view_image原图及底面裁片；方形浅密檐砖塔，灰白砖石材质与宋构基线相容，无字无人。可见底边约+.508/-.505；主受光左侧，右侧接触影保留。首稿误生成瓦顶楼阁塔已淘汰。现图为千寻塔意象，未达到文物16级的逐层复原（待考/原创构图）；高宽比与实际塔高不作考古认证。
